note: exploratory controls, computed after the locked G18 analysis (scripts/184 stage=analyze); not preregistered

within_task_and_tool.reading: within the same task and tool the read-out is weaker (0.61, interval includes 0.5): part of the within-tool signal separates violation-prone situations across tasks rather than individual writes

task_tool_prior_from_other_episodes_labe.reading: a prior that knows each task and tool's violation rate from labelled other episodes (not available for a new task) ranks well; the read-out is only weakly correlated with it and adds to it
